_about: Public-domain William Palmer of Magdalen (1811-1879), the Anglican deacon who sought communion with the Orthodox Church and later became a Catholic, for the Word Hoard: his Dissertations on subjects relating to the Orthodox or Eastern-Catholic Communion (1853) and Notes of a Visit to the Russian Church in 1840-41, selected and arranged by Cardinal Newman (1882), from Internet Archive scans. Not William Palmer of Worcester College, who has his own shelf. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 35 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
